body:
Shows Olokun the work behind Zarathian stonecraft, water engineering and a teacher’s memorial.

Recorded role and choices

Fenwae offers Olokun a mine visit, explains why good building stone matters and shows a mountain-lake dam project. He says the work is discussed with the Verdant Circle and describes choosing marble for a memorial to Xo. In their later exchange about Aria, Fenwae’s admiration and Olokun’s differing account remain attributed perspectives. His masonry, practical hospitality and willingness to keep talking are established without making his defense of Zarathian society objective fact.
